> **⚠️ Before you post**
>
> **This issue tracker is public.** Never include:
>
> - Your IP address, ISP name, city, or ASN
> - Working config strings, subscription URLs, UUIDs, or keys
> - Screenshots showing any of the above
>
> If you are reporting from a censored network, an unattributed summary
> ("Reality stopped working on a major mobile carrier around <date>") is more
> useful to us than a detailed report that identifies you. Do not post from an
> account you would not want linked to circumvention work.
>
> Anything that would expose live infrastructure or a person belongs in a private
> report — see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
